opensource.description: Open2 builds in public whenever possible. Open-source is not just a strategy, it is a tool for collective learning and democratizing technology.
opensource.philosophyText: Some projects are production-ready, others are experimental explorations. We value the process of building as much as the final product.

facodi.name: FACODI
facodi.desc: An open educational platform focused on democratizing access to higher education. It organizes academic curricula into learning paths and playlists, making university-level knowledge accessible, free, and community-driven.

monynhafun.name: Monynha Fun
monynhafun.desc: An open-source video curation platform focused on organizing YouTube content into meaningful playlists and collections. Exploring content discovery and lightweight social interaction around educational media.

botecowebsite.name: BotecoPRO Website
botecowebsite.desc: The official website for BotecoPRO, an open-source bar and restaurant management ecosystem. This project serves as the public-facing layer of the platform, focusing on clarity and onboarding.

botecoapp.name: BotecoPRO App
botecoapp.desc: A mobile-first management tool designed for bars and restaurants. It focuses on daily operations, usability, and real-world workflows, connecting staff through a simple digital interface.

opensource.signalsDescription: Our repositories are open spaces. Explore the code, fork a project, test our prototypes, or open an issue. Experimentation and community feedback are what move these ecosystems forward.
opensource.closingQuote: The best technology is built by people who are not afraid to share their work.
